name: ID.me Teacher Discounts
description: Exclusive teacher discounts at many stores after one-time educator verification
fullDescription: ID.me lets teachers and other school employees verify their educator status once to unlock exclusive discounts from hundreds of stores and brands through ID.me Shop.
whatTheyOffer:
- Teacher discounts from hundreds of stores and brands on ID.me Shop
- Verify once with your ID.me Wallet, then use discounts without re-verifying
- Discounts applied at checkout wherever you see "Verify with ID.me"
- Eligible: PreK-12 teachers, substitutes, aides, principals, school staff (counselors, nurses, librarians, cafeteria, office, IT), and college professors/faculty
- Not eligible: retired teachers, teachers with expired credentials, uncertified homeschool teachers
howToGetIt:
1. Create a free ID.me account
2. Choose teacher verification
3. Enter your teacher number, state, district, and school, or upload official documents
4. Once verified, browse teacher discounts on shop.id.me
5. Look for the "Verify with ID.me" button at participating stores
keywords: ID.me, teacher discount, educator discount, school staff, professors, classroom supplies, ID.me Shop, teacher verification
